rawContent: I've definitely been attacked for it, and I've pushed back. We have huge scars from the Akai Gurley and Peter Liang case here in New York City. Sometimes I and comrades wonder what we lost and won when we declared #BlackLivesMatter aloud. It still hurts. #miseduAsian
Thank you to @caaav who stood up for Akai Gurley when it was right and then got attacked so damn hard for declaring #BlackLivesMatter. #miseduAsian

I wrote about that experience here as I participated in @BLMAtSchool Week of Action in NYC and contemplated the #BlackLivesMatter intergenerational principle within my community and myself: #miseduAsian https://t.co/t3sSdXSOF9

@DominiqueJL15 @katchow Much appreciated, Dominique. Crazy that was 4 years ago. Was a direct impetus for me moving back to NYC, to organize, be in relationship with my family <3 and to work around solidarity and #BlackLivesMatter

For a lot of reasons, I was more ready and able to share about the CNN team being arrested by the Minnesota State Police today than about George Floyd's murder. I still have a lot to work on. All us non-Black people have a lot to work on. #BlackLivesMatter #GeorgeFloydWasMurdered
WHATTTTT?! Are you kidding me?! @NYPDnews #BlackLivesMatter
I am ashamed of @NYCMayor. #BlackLivesMatter

Today the last day of #APAHM I'm performing on a Zoom fundraiser 7pm to raise $ for Chinatown. Now I'm up cuz I gotta tell a diff story: of how #Asians4BlackLives & the #BlackLivesMatter movement brought me home. Asian Americans, it's more impt than ever we speak up now. 1/

Asian Americans had to reckon with the #BlackLivesMatter movement, knowing a Chinese Asian American cop #PeterLiang killed #AkaiGurley. Many friends were mad Liang was guilty but the cop who killed #EricGarner roamed free. Many thought Liang should be freed. #Asians4BlackLives 4/

Lily Chin, my great-auntie, fought to get justice for her son Vincent Chin & racial justice coalitions that fought w/ my family: there's Jesse Jackson right next to her. Now, more than ever, we Asian Americans need to fight and declare #BlackLivesMatter #Asians4BlackLives 9/ https://t.co/VZjyoMkGGc

My family was SO mad at me because I invoked my cousin Vincent Chin's name w/ the #BlackLivesMatter movement. I didn't realize until then how much anti-Black racism is w/in my family, even tho we fought so hard for justice ourselves for Vincent! We weren't #Asians4BlackLives. 11/

I was heartbroken. I'd been fighting in Chicago for #BlackLivesMatter & public education for my low-income students of color with @CTULocal1. And to feel the chasm w/in my own family around #Asians4BlackLives felt enormous. My family and I, we didn't understand each other. 12/

We Asian Americans were still creating language around what it meant to be #Asians4BlackLives. When #PhilandoCastile was killed later that summer 2016, many crowdsourced to create language resources to talk with our community around #BlackLivesMatter. https://t.co/5pbKKnHFib

It is our duty, Asian Americans, to learn our history AND the history of racial justice coalitions we've had with other communities of color. It's up to us to NOT be a model minority wedge. We need to fight for justice and declare #BlackLivesMatter. #Asians4BlackLives 20/

It is our duty as allies to #BlackLivesMatter to develop relationships with & build community with our Asian American comrades, to build deep and to combat the anti-Black racism that white supremacy taught us. We have to also unlearn it. It's a DEEEP well. #Asians4BlackLives 21/

I am hopeful in my community because I have to be. It will take ALL of us to shift things. It starts with declaring #BlackLivesMatter and, if you or your family can't right now, really, truly, deciphering why, together. 

I hope we build a movement of #Asians4BlackLives. 24/25

Assata Shakur:

It is our duty to fight for our freedom.
It is our duty to win.
We must love each other and support each other.
We have nothing to lose but our chains.

We have nothing to lose but our chains.

#BlackLivesMatter #Asians4BlackLives 25/25

So start with making remote learning equitable now, then continue to push integration in our school system, don't enforce a hiring freeze on @NYCSchools, fund #CounselorsNotCops, and don't cut our city education budget. We educators have to declare out loud #BlackLivesMatter.

I know a lot of us have coworkers with problematic viewpoints. If you can't declare #BlackLivesMatter without a caveat, you've got a problem. And yet, as an educator, knowing you've got coworkers who can't declare that, then teaching students of color? How do you deal with that?!

Been too damn scared as an untenured teacher to really confront this 😥 (that changes in Sept!). I do what I think's right by my students, but wow, to think of all the educators out there who are supposed to teach our students who can't utter #BlackLivesMatter aloud w/o a caveat.

Me, to my partner, who's Chinese Asian American like me: Do #BlackLivesMatter ?

Partner: Yeah... (duh, cuz it's obvious)

That's how everyone should answer this question! Ughhhhhh.

Who knew pandemic-induced insomnia would give way to this insomnia?

If it took this much time to (not) convince ppl to believe in science & physically distance...

We've got a long road ahead in this power struggle. I'm ready to talk to my students tomorrow.

#BlackLivesMatter

Talk with* my students

Watching my language. My students are full of experience and love and ideas and I'm not going to indoctrinate them with my views tomorrow, but we'll talk the truth of what is happening. At a developmentally appropriate level, of course.

#BlackLivesMatter
@JennJ59026262 You don't care about the murders of Black folk, so no, that's a nonstarter. And that should be a nonstarter for any educator teaching kids of color. #BlackLivesMatter

PSYCHIC DAMAGE. What kinds of psychic damage happen? For me, it was spending an hour today trying to stretch and take in that I haven't been vocal enough to my staff that #GeorgeFloydWasMurdered and #BlackLivesMatter. And being ashamed I'm not be doing enough. #miseducAsian
